```{python}
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

data = pd.read_csv("data/movies_clean.csv")
```

```{python}
plt.clf()
cleaned_data = data.copy()

pre_covid_mask = cleaned_data["release_year"].between(2017, 2019)
covid_mask = cleaned_data["release_year"].between(2020, 2023)
post_covid_mask = cleaned_data["release_year"].between(2024, 2026)

pre_covid_movies = cleaned_data[pre_covid_mask]
covid_movies = cleaned_data[covid_mask]
post_covid_movies = cleaned_data[post_covid_mask]
```


```{python}
combined = pd.concat([
    pre_covid_movies.assign(Time='pre_covid'),
    covid_movies.assign(Time='covid'),
    post_covid_movies.assign(Time='post_covid')
])

combined.boxplot(by='Time', column=["vote_avg"])
```

```{python}
# denisty of vote score by time period
plt.clf()
pre_covid_movies["vote_avg"].plot.density(label="pre-covid")
covid_movies["vote_avg"].plot.density(label="covid")
post_covid_movies["vote_avg"].plot.density(label="post-covid")
cleaned_data["vote_avg"].plot.density(label="all years")
plt.legend()
plt.xlabel("Vote Average Score")
```

```{python}
len(pre_covid_movies) + len(covid_movies) + len(post_covid_movies)

plt.clf()
cleaned_data.groupby("release_year").agg(avg_profit=("profit", "mean")).plot.line()

plt.clf()
cleaned_data.groupby("release_year").agg(avg_budget=("budget", "mean")).plot.line()

plt.clf()
cleaned_data.groupby("release_year").agg(avg_rev=("revenue", "mean")).plot.line()
```
